title: Create / edit dialog: a unique-index refusal says "A record with this value already exists" without naming or highlighting the field
body:
Filing gate **① a product defect with a reproduction**. Found by the HotCRM full browser pass objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2320 on `@objectstack/*` 18.2.0: track 2 Revenue (report comment 6444188882 on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2320, finding D4; screenshots on branch `claude/project-thread-urevq9` under `qa/` and in the HotCRM project files `qa-2320/2-revenue/`); track 1 Sales (report comment 6443461344 on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2320, finding S11 (account name); screenshots on branch `claude/project-thread-2kd6ha` under `qa/` and in the HotCRM project files `qa-2320/sales/`). Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`huangyiirene`, session `session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5`), which re-read each finding against its screenshot. Batch-of: hotcrm#2320 platform findings.

`finding` class **a** · `reach:` public door: the console on `@objectstack/*` 18.2.0, measured in Chromium against the HotCRM seed.

## What is seen

- New Product with SKU `QA-2320-SKU` when that SKU exists → "A record with this value already exists", no field highlighted (`prd-12-create-dup-sku.png`).
- New Account named like an existing one → the same sentence; it does not say which field, nor link the existing record (`acc-04-dup-name-result.png`).

**Who loses:** the user has to guess which of the form's unique fields collided.

## Expected

The refusal names the field by its label and marks it in the form (the field-level error the form already draws for `required`).

## Dedupe

`search_issues` objectstack "unique constraint duplicate message A record with this value already exists does not name field": 8 hits. **#7821** (closed) "REST: the UNIQUE_VIOLATION 409 message is hard-coded English and carries no field" is the same complaint at the REST layer; on 18.2.0 the console still shows the generic sentence with no field, so either the field now on the wire is not used by the dialog, or #7821's fix did not reach this path — the reader measures which. Others: #24951, #23701, #22105, #15631 (closed, other aspects).

**Reader who acts:** the console form dialog owner (`domain:ui`), with the REST error shape from #7821.
